title: Progress 90 Cargo Ship Docking – Saturday, November 23, 2024
description: The uncrewed Roscosmos ISS Progress 90 cargo spacecraft docked to the Poisk module November 23 after launching to the International Space Station from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan November 21 on a Soyuz booster rocket. Progress is filled with nearly three tons of supplies and cargo and will remain docked to the space station for approximately six months.
